goal: Allow nodes to relay and accept Taproot transactions containing marker-only or unstructured annexes
Enable standard relay for marker-based opt-in and arbitrary data in Taproot transactions
agreement: Approval without stated reasons after earlier comments and P2A input handling were addressed (petertodd)
Questioned the value of standardizing annexes before consensus meaning or active use exists (sipa)

categories.name: mempool
why: P3 because it relaxes relay policy to permit marker-only and unstructured Taproot annexes
Utility remains limited while annexes lack consensus meaning or active network demand
